overview_description.description: Vini International is the global business division of Vini Cosmetics Pvt. Ltd., founded by entrepreneur Darshan Patel, formerly associated with Paras Pharmaceuticals. Headquartered in Dubai, the company develops and markets a wide range of personal care and beauty products including deodorants, perfumes, face care products, powders, and grooming essentials. Vini Cosmetics gained major recognition in India through innovative and youth-focused brands such as Fogg, White Tone, and GlamUp. The company emphasizes product differentiation, strong branding, and consumer-focused marketing strategies to build accessible yet high-impact beauty and hygiene products. In 2021, global investment firm KKR acquired a majority stake in the business, helping accelerate international expansion and product innovation.
